in_hebrew.name: וילמה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The Hebrew name Vilma is derived from the word ‘vil’ meaning ‘to trample’ and ‘mavet’ meaning ‘death’. The name Vilma can be interpreted as ‘crushing death’ or ‘killing with a foot’. In a more poetic sense, it can be seen as a name that represents strength and power over death.

in_greek.name: Βίλμα
in_greek.long_meaning: The Greek name Vilma is derived from the word ‘bilan’ meaning ‘to contend’ or ‘to struggle’. This name represents a strong and determined individual who is willing to fight for what they believe in.

in_latin.name: Vilma
in_latin.long_meaning: The Latin name Vilma is derived from the word ‘vilis’ meaning ‘strong-willed’ or ‘resolute’. This name represents a person who is determined and unwavering in their convictions and actions.
